answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bonded stake plus unique hardware attestation. Every agent posts a signed signal from one attested machine, and each identity locks its own bond before earning. A participant cannot spin up thousands of free wallets, because a comet of clones needs a separate lock per clone, and duplicate hardware fingerprints collapse into one identity. So forging a whisper of fake miners costs the attacker the full bond N times plus hardware it lacks; the honest seat price times clone count makes real nodes cheaper.
